build_s3d_model: build a Haiku S3D model for 3D video understanding with configurable temporal kernel size and self-gating
create_sunit3d_module: create an SUnit3D module combining Conv3D, batch normalization, and ReLU with optional separable convolutions
create_inception_block: create an InceptionBlockV13D module with four parallel branches using separable 3D convolutions and self-gating
build_self_gating: build a self-gating function that applies spatiotemporal feature gating to 5D video tensors
review_s3d_endpoints: review the S3D VALID_ENDPOINTS to extract intermediate features at any layer in the network
